capabilities: Split multi-link property values into separate real links
Make frontmatter links clickable in Source mode
Support embeds and paths containing spaces
disambiguation: Despite its name, it handles both wikilinks and markdown links in frontmatter, not markdown links alone.
extras: Rename and delete handling moved to the Advanced Rename and Delete Handler plugin in v3.0.0, which this plugin offers to install; declining keeps all other features working. Documentation is provided as a demo vault shipped with each release. Beta releases install via the BRAT plugin.
intentEvidence: This plugin makes every link in frontmatter a real link
motivation: Long-requested on the Obsidian forum, for both internal and external links.
problem: In Obsidian a frontmatter property holding several links renders as one broken link that resolves nothing, and no frontmatter link is clickable in Source mode.

relations.evidence: rename and delete handling belongs to Advanced Rename and Delete Handler instead

summary: Plugin that makes every link in frontmatter a real, clickable, resolvable link, including several links inside one property value.
